paite: Mi tengteng aw, hiai ngaikhia unla; khovel a om tengteng aw, bildoh un.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding; Korah Tate La / Hauhsakna Muan Ahaihuaina
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

paite: Mineu leh milian, mihau leh mizawng in leng.
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

paite: Ka kam in pilna thu agen ding a; ka lungtang ngaihtuah tuh theihsiamna thu ahi ding hi.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

paite: Genteh thu ah ka bil ka doh ding a; ka thugil gen kaihging in ka gentel ding hi.
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

paite: Ni hoihloute ah, ka khetul bul a thulimlouhna in hon umsuak in leng, bang ding in ka lau dia!
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

paite: Amau neih-le-lam muang a, amau hauhna tampi suangte'n.
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

paite: Kuamah in a-unau atan thei kei ding uh, Pathian kiang ah tatna leng apiaksak thei sam kei ding uhi.
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

paite: Ahinna uh tatna ding in tatna man atam lua a, tangtawn a leng angim louh mai ding ahi.
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

paite: Adam gige a, muatna amuhlouhna ding in.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

paite: Mipilte asi ua, huai bang in, mihai leh mimawlte leng amang tuaktuak ua, aneih-le-lam uh midangte anutsiat zel uhi.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

paite: Alungsim ngaihtuahdan uh, a-innte uh tangtawn a om ding bang leh, a-omnate uh suan tengteng tan a om ding bang in ahi; agamte uh amau min mah atamsak uhi.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

paite: Himahleh mihing pahtawi in a-om gige kei ua; gamsa mangthangte bang ahi uhi.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

paite: Hiai kihaimuante tuah ahi a, atan ua kipakte tawpna. Selah
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

paite: Belamhon bang in Sheol a ding a seh ahi, sihna amaute avak ding hi, zingsang lam in midiktatte'n atung uah thu anei ding ua; a-omnate ua a-omlouhna ding in, akilawmna uh Sheol hihsiat ding ahi ding hi.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

paite: Ka hinna bel Pathian in Sheol thilhihtheihna a kipan atankhe ding a; ama'n ahon kipahpih ding hi. Selah
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

paite: Mi hihhauh a ahong om a, a-insung thupina ahong thupi huthut in leng, lau ke'n.
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

paite: Asih hun chiang in bangmah akeng kei ding hi; athupina in zui khe lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

paite: Adam lai in nuamsa mahleh, adamsung in phat loh mahleh.
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

paite: Amah suangtute lam ah apai dia, vak amu ngei kei ding uh.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

paite: Mihing, pahtawi a om a, theihsiamna nei tuan lou zaw, gamsa mangthang zelte bang phet ahi uhi.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
